# Fieldia 0.14.0 (vendored)

`fieldia.js` is the unmodified browser bundle from the npm package
`@fieldia/viewer@0.14.0` (`bundle/fieldia.js`, MIT — see `LICENSE`). It sets the
global `Fieldia`. The robot timeline demo uses it for its settings popups
(`Fieldia.openFormDialog`).

To update: `npm pack @fieldia/viewer@<version>`, copy `package/bundle/fieldia.js`
and `package/LICENSE` here, and rename this folder.
